description: Change a milestone. Rename a milestone, change its description or target date, or move it in the trail's order with `position` (the others shift to make room). Pass at least one field; the rest are left as they are.

description.description: What the milestone delivers; `null` clears it.

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

position.description: Move it to this place in the trail's order, from `0`; the others shift to make room.

targetDate.description: The calendar day it is meant to be done by (`YYYY-MM-DD`); `null` clears it.

name: trails_milestones_update
